description: Attaches the payer's EIP-712 authorization to a created session: POST /v1/sessions/:id/authorize. The signature is produced locally by the payer's wallet (or precomputed and passed as payer_signature). Moves the session to state 'authorized'. No funds move until capture.

payer_signature.description: EIP-712 signature (0x, 65 bytes) of the session authorization typed data, signed by the payer wallet.

name: phantom_authorize_session

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.

title: Authorize a payment session
